title: Astra Data Factory Source Spec, version 0
description: A machine-readable description of one custodian file layout (product spec Section 4): the records it contains, every field's position, picture and type, and where in the layout document each field is defined. One file per version, at specs/<id>/<version>.yaml.

id.description: Layout id, shared by every custodian that delivers this layout; the directory name.

version.description: This version; the file name without extension.

effective_from.description: Business date from which this version is in force.

custodians.description: Custodians that deliver files on this layout.

family.description: Layout family, assigned by the Pattern Matcher.

provider.description: Who publishes the layout, for example the clearing firm.

reference.description: File name or URL of the layout document citations point into.

quote.description: Field enclosure in a delimited file; default is a double quote.

escape.description: Character that escapes a quote inside a quoted field. When absent, a quote is written twice.

header_rows.description: Column-name rows to skip in a delimited file. The first is checked against field labels when they are declared.

column_count.description: Number of columns every data row must have in a delimited file. A row with another count rejects the file.

merge.description: How a file changes Silver: a header flag says whether the file is a full refresh (replaces every row of its scope as of the business date) or an update (merges on keys, untouched rows carried forward).

record.description: Logical record merged into Silver: a detail record label or a pairing name. Defaults to the only one.

mode_field.description: Header field whose code decides the mode.

modes.description: Code of mode_field to mode. Both refresh and update must appear.

scope.description: Header fields that identify the partition a refresh replaces, for example the remote id. Empty means the whole source.

business_date_field.description: Header date field giving the business date the file is as of.

keys.description: Fields of the merged record that identify a row.

split.description: Rules that turn one custodian record into several canonical records, for example a DRIP record into a dividend and a purchase.

record.description: Logical record the rule applies to.

set.description: Field values this part gets; null clears a field.

negate.description: Numeric fields whose sign is flipped in this part.

lifecycle.description: How cancel and correction records relate to the originals they refer to.

record.description: Logical record the lifecycle applies to.

action_field.description: Field whose code says whether a row is new, a cancel or a correction.

actions.description: Code of action_field to action. Codes not listed are treated as new.

reference.description: Fields of a cancel or correction naming the original, in the same order as identity.

pairing.description: Detail record types that together form one logical record, joined on key fields present in each. A record whose partner is missing is reported as PAIR_INCOMPLETE.

records.description: Record labels (names of detail records) that make up one logical record, in the order their fields are merged.

keys.description: Fields, present in every listed record, whose equal values pair the records.

name.description: Required when a file has more than one detail record type.

position.description: Fixed-length record type token in a fixed-width file.

start.description: With end_marker: the token starts here and runs up to the marker.

end_marker.description: Character that ends the record type token.

column.description: Delimited files: the column holding the record type.

match.description: How a line is recognised as this record type: a fixed-length token at a position, a token from a start position up to an end marker, or a column.

label.description: Column heading as written in the header row of a delimited file; checked when header_rows is set.

picture.description: COBOL-style picture as written in the layout document.

type.description: Derived from the picture when omitted.

format.description: For dates and times, for example YYYYMMDD.

sign_field.description: Field in the same record that carries this number's sign. Which of its codes mean positive, negative or unknown is declared on those codes.

sign_style.description: separate (default): the sign is in sign_field. leading: a '+' or '-' at the start of the digits, absent for positive.

document.description: When the citation is not into the spec's own document.

sign.description: On the codes of a sign field: what this code means for the number that references it.
